title: Sustainability and Engagement
summary: Sustainability, projects, engagement, and community action.
whyItMatters: Local sustainability becomes concrete through everyday resource use, community projects, volunteers, responsibilities, and measurable goals.

mentalModel.title: Problem, action, result
mentalModel.content: Name the local issue, the proposed action, and the change it should produce.

mentalModel.title: Individual and shared action connect
mentalModel.content: Personal habits matter, but projects also need infrastructure, coordination, and participation.

ruleBlocks.title: Organize sustainability vocabulary
ruleBlocks.content: Group energy, transport, food, waste, water, repair, reuse, and green spaces.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe a community project
ruleBlocks.content: Include goal, target group, tasks, materials, schedule, partners, and expected result.

ruleBlocks.title: Use realistic impact language
ruleBlocks.content: Say reduzieren, sparen, vermeiden, wiederverwenden, verbessern, and Menschen erreichen.

examples.de: Unsere Initiative organisiert einmal im Monat ein Repair-Café.
examples.en: Our initiative organizes a repair café once a month.

examples.de: Das Projekt soll Lebensmittel retten und Menschen zusammenbringen.
examples.en: The project is intended to save food and bring people together.

examples.de: Wir brauchen Freiwillige, die bei der Verteilung helfen.
examples.en: We need volunteers who help with distribution.

commonMistakes.wrong: Call an action sustainable without naming its effect.
commonMistakes.correct: Explain which resource or problem it changes.
commonMistakes.reason: Sustainability claims need a clear connection.

comparisons.summary: Relative clauses describe people, projects, and objects more precisely.
The communication lesson supports discussion of competing project ideas.
